title: Towards Robust Evaluation: A Comprehensive Taxonomy of Datasets and Metrics for Open Domain Question Answering in the Era of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing existing literature (e.g., LLM-as-a-Judge) to evaluate the tendency of Large Language Model evaluators to unfairly favor certain answer positions over others.

Reviewing existing literature to evaluate the tendency of Large Language Model evaluators to assign higher scores to longer, more verbose responses, even if they are less accurate than shorter alternatives.
Reviewing existing literature to evaluate the tendency of Large Language Model evaluators to unfairly favor and assign higher scores to answers generated by their own underlying model.
